title: Graphite: Its Properties, Occurrence, Refining and Uses
version: Canadian Mines Branch report, extracted pages
lineage: The 1907 report says the Bessel brothers used graphite refining on a large scale and dates a change in the earlier method to 1887. It reports the later variant treating ore from Kropfmuehle; the precise date and site of the initial operation are not directly established.

passages.note: Printed pp. 218–219: Bessel large-scale process and dated 1887 modification
